title: Rice by the Gate
lines: Ten hens live by the lake.
Jane sets rice in a dish at nine.
"Some of the rice is gone!" she said.
Pete finds a rat in the shed.
The rat has some rice in his hole.
"Let him come and have a bite," said Jane.
The rat gets cake by the gate.
The hens have rice, and all is well.

questions.ask: Where does Pete find the rat?
questions.listenFor: In the shed, with rice in his hole.

questions.ask: What do Jane and Pete set out for the rat?
questions.listenFor: Cake, by the gate. Let them find the line.

questions.ask: Was it kind to give the rat his own snack? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is right. Listen for a reason, such as "yes, because now he is not hungry."
